## Advocacia — Negócio
Indicadores de uso da Plataforma (Fase 0), derivados das requisições HTTP bem-sucedidas por endpoint. Quando os módulos de negócio (Fase 1+) emitirem eventos próprios (`customEvents`), acrescentar aqui.

content.title: Logins bem-sucedidos por hora
content.query:
requests
| where name has 'auth/login' and toint(resultCode) between (200 .. 299)
| summarize logins = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h)

content.title: Logins com falha por hora (4xx)
content.query:
requests
| where name has 'auth/login' and toint(resultCode) between (400 .. 499)
| summarize failures = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h)

content.title: Escritórios (tenants) criados por dia
content.query:
requests
| where name startswith 'POST' and name endswith '/tenants' and toint(resultCode) between (200 .. 299)
| summarize created = count() by bin(timestamp, 1d)

content.title: Convites enviados/aceitos por dia
content.query:
requests
| where name startswith 'POST' and name has '/users' and (name has 'invite' or name has 'accept') and toint(resultCode) between (200 .. 299)
| summarize total = count() by name, bin(timestamp, 1d)

content.title: Endpoints mais usados
content.query:
requests
| summarize calls = count(), failures = countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500), p95Ms = percentile(duration, 95) by name
| top 25 by calls desc

content.title: Usuários distintos ativos por dia
content.query:
requests
| where isnotempty(user_AuthenticatedId)
| summarize activeUsers = dcount(user_AuthenticatedId) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
